Spec: enforce the 30-day data retention policy.
Personal records of closed accounts must be deleted thirty days after closure: profile, uploaded files,
and message history. Invoices are kept for seven years because tax law requires it, but the personal
fields on them are redacted at day thirty. The deletion runs nightly, is idempotent, and writes one
audit row per account with the counts removed, so a regulator can check that the policy actually ran.
A dry-run flag prints what would be deleted without deleting it.
